You may know it from Led Zeppelin but not even Leadbelly was the first. This song was originally known as The Maid Freed From The Gallows and was from somewhere in continental Europe - and even the Irish have had their turn at it, as it was a pub song in Ireland. There have been many newer recordings but this one is Huddy's and was the first recording. How it got to America, we don't really know.
